speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me determine the cause, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you noticed any rash, stiff neck, or muscle aches?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your pregnancy and the sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia, could you tell me if your friends or coworkers have been sick recently, and have you noticed any sensitivity to light?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count; REQUEST TEST: Serum_Lactate

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC 15,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000 /μL; Serum_Lactate: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work shows an elevated white blood cell count of 15,000, while your hemoglobin and platelets are normal, and your lactate is within normal limits. Given your pregnancy, sudden fever, headache, and anorexia, have you noticed any nuchal rigidity (stiff neck) or photophobia (sensitivity to light)?

REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_CT_with_contrast; REQUEST TEST: CSF_Analysis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CSF_Analysis: NORMAL READINGS; Brain_CT_with_contrast: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
The CSF analysis and Brain CT are both normal, which effectively rules out meningitis and brain abscess despite your severe symptoms. With the infection in the central nervous system excluded, have you experienced any back pain, urinary urgency, or changes in your urine color or frequency?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Appearance Clear, WBC 0-5 /HPF, RBC 0-2 /HPF, Protein Negative, Glucose Negative; Urine_Culture: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
The urinalysis and urine culture results are normal, which rules out a urinary tract infection as the cause of your fever and headache. I have used 4 of my allowed questions. To further narrow down the cause, could you describe the specific character of your headache (e.g., is it severe, sudden, or throbbing) and have you noticed any changes in your vision, taste, or smell?

REQUEST TEST: C-Reactive_Protein; REQUEST TEST: Viral_Serology_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: C-Reactive_Protein: Elevated; Viral_Serology_Panel: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The clinical picture of fever, headache, anorexia, and malaise in a third-trimester pregnant woman, combined with elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, WBC) and the exclusion of meningitis, UTI, and viral causes, is highly suggestive of Listeria, especially given the history of ice cream consumption.
